scope: R01–R06 follow-up to LAYOUT_ACCEPTANCE.json. Local Linux/WSL execution-row, scoped-display, final-label-row and text-facade acceptance; no wire-shape change.

inspectedMechanisms: man.c/man_term.c empty text and no-fill word execution
mdoc.c/mdoc_term.c NODE_LINE, empty word and print_bvspace predecessor handling

groff.role: Independent source/behavior check; no copied implementation or third-party tests

fixtures.ledgerComparison: Layout, fidelity and structure replays are byte-identical to the checked-in reviewed CSVs. Retained rclone layout candidate and content candidates, and expected groff macro-recursion failure, are not new clean results.

gcc.explain: --explain=--help returned two direct owners plus seven other evidence owners; exit 0. Existing incomplete-semantics diagnostics remain visible.
gcc.node: --node 4.2/e84 retains undocumented, joined, separate, both following examples and the final inverted-qualifier restriction.

btrfs.explain: --explain=create returned the command body, Options, -i <qgroupid> and its description; exit 0.

verification.crossReview: Three parallel implementation/review passes; adjacent empty-literal gap reset, empty display predecessor, list-kind boundaries, fi/nf transitions, empty font operands and Fo/Fa/Eo/Ec execution boundaries received fixes and regressions. Final documentation reviewed independently.
exclusions: No native Windows/macOS execution in this pass.
No new full-host or 45,036-source canonical sweep.
Reference page furniture, soft wrapping, justification and documented no-space differences are not byte-equality assertions.
Local logs are supplementary hashes, not required inputs for reproducing the committed source/test matrix.

probes.priorCases: All 46 original cases in LAYOUT_ACCEPTANCE.json replayed against the final producer and both references.
probes.review: Compared the 15 reduced follow-up cases by source-token rows, blank-row counts and relative origins. Preserved the previous record's intentional formatter differences; successful execution of the 46-case replay is not an assertion of byte-identical output.
probes.caseLicense: Original reduced inputs authored for ManT; Apache-2.0.
